extract_mm_projector: extract multimodal projector weights from a LLaVA v1.5 PyTorch checkpoint and save to llava.projector
extract_clip_tensors: extract vision tower CLIP tensors from a LLaVA checkpoint and save to llava.clip
clean_added_tokens: clean added_tokens.json to empty JSON object for Mistral model conversion compatibility
load_pytorch_checkpoint: load a LLaVA PyTorch model checkpoint from pytorch_model*.bin files
prepare_llava_for_gguf: prepare a LLaVA v1.5 model for GGUF conversion by extracting projector and CLIP weights
